label: preparing
what: A jubilee celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, arranged around the 18:00 great-hall lighting inspection and builder escort. Baker, Freight and innkeeper are coordinating a target of 200 loaves: 152 fresh loaves are verified delivered, with grain and the final 48 still unconfirmed. Builder is arranging the lantern inspection; secretary knowingly assists with scheduling and supply reconciliation. The jubilee is now known to me, although the preparations were initially not presented as such.
